label: Pre-encounter — the tenth door
location: The desert hall before the hatchery tunnels

recentEvents.value: Nine realms' warnings arrived ahead of him; the evacuation bells have been ringing since his gate-light touched the sand.
The burrow-cities are emptying beneath her; the hatchery-mothers are awake.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Past nine guardians' warnings, still armed, still coming — and he understands every word.

temporaryObjective.value: Expel the trespasser: name him envoy, name the exits, name the law.
